text: [MUSIC: A single lute plays the opening melody of "Not Enough Time."] [MUSIC: The orchestra grows.] [MUSIC: A plaintive violin enters.] [MUSIC: Full strings swell into the chorus of "Not Enough Time," sung by the machine's own voice, about 40 seconds.] [MUSIC: The chorus climbs again, louder.] [MUSIC: Stops dead. SFX: A tiny mechanical click.] [MUSIC: The "Not Enough Time" melody returns, softer, solo lute.] [MUSIC: The orchestra takes the explanation out of his mouth. A new, warm motif begins.] [SONG: "Make It With Me," about 1:45, sung by the machine. Lyrics in songs/make-it-with-me.md.] [MU
